scope: A source-separation and persistence discipline for human and machine records; not an ontology of reality or a folder taxonomy.

stages.name: Signal
stages.object_definition: A sensed, voiced, clicked, or streamed event before an admitted semantic structure.
stages.expires_when: Its declared intake window closes unless a Data object is created.

stages.name: Data
stages.object_definition: Addressable bytes with content identity, size, time, source boundary, and retention state; still semantically mute.
stages.expires_when: Its retention purpose or service window ends unless a structured successor is created.

stages.name: Information
stages.object_definition: Data plus an explicit schema, transformation, interpretation boundary, and provenance trail.
stages.expires_when: Its usefulness or rights basis expires and no cited claim depends on it.

stages.name: Knowledge
stages.object_definition: A typed proposition linked to admitted Information, explicit warrant, confidence, rivals, and defeaters; not truth by label.
stages.expires_when: It is revoked, contradicted, unsupported, or superseded; the predecessor record remains traceable.

stages.name: Judgment
stages.object_definition: Knowledge joined to a scoped decision by a named bearer, with authority state, reversibility, cost, and expected consequence visible.
writers: agent only within an already valid charter
stages.expires_when: The decision is revoked or superseded; the audit receipt remains under applicable retention law.

stages.name: Wisdom
stages.object_definition: A reusable, versioned policy distilled from Judgment with scope, outcome evidence, rivals, kills, correction lineage, and authority boundary.
writers: named policy bearer under separate authority
stages.expires_when: It is contested, superseded, retracted, or its mandate ends; lineage remains visible where lawful.

requirements: bind source, time, rights, and retention
cite admitted sources and expose warrant, rivals, and defeaters
record a scoped decision by a named bearer
bind authority state, cost, reversibility, and expected consequence
derive a reusable policy without erasing the Judgment
bind independent outcomes, scope, rivals, kills, correction, and policy authority

forbidden_skips: A raw signal or byte object may not be called Knowledge.
A structured transcript or model output may not promote itself to Knowledge.
A claim, recommendation, or proposal may not be presented as Judgment without a decision bearer.
A repeated Judgment may not become Wisdom without policy scope, outcomes, kills, correction, and authority.
A commit, receipt, publication event, model consensus, or polished interface may not be presented as an outcome or truth upgrade.
A grave may not be resurrected in place; any renewed proposition needs a successor ID and fresh warrant.
A product may apply or contest Emergentism but may not promote its own application into Emergentism doctrine.
